in_marathi.name: Adhish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adhish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'adh', meaning 'towards'. The name Adhish signifies the one who is the master or lord, ruling over a domain or an aspect of life. In Hindu mythology, Adhish is a name of various gods and goddesses, such as Adhish Shiva, the god of destruction, and Adhish Parvati, the goddess of love and fertility.
